Home › Track my bus live
Roxgold SiteLife.
Tracking your bus live.
On the road, you often wait with no information:
where is the bus?
When will it arrive?
You end up calling the driver.
With Roxgold SiteLife, you track your bus live,
from your phone.
From the day of departure,
your home screen shows your trip.
Tap
Track my bus live.
The map shows the bus, the distance already covered in green,
and your stop, in gold.
Just below: the estimated arrival time,
the time and kilometres left.
The route lists the stops:
those already passed, where you get on, then where you get off.
You can see which towns the bus is between.
The position updates every fifteen seconds.
Tracking is also available from the Trips page:
Track live.
No more waiting blind: you know where the bus is
and when it will arrive.
Roxgold SiteLife.
